neighbor_algorithm.name: sampled_boundary_contact
neighbor_algorithm.description: SVG paths are sampled along their boundaries. Two provinces are neighbors when enough sampled boundary points from both shapes fall within a small distance threshold and the contact spans more than a tiny point touch.

2022.population_source: Eurostat demo_r_pjanaggr3, downloaded from the Eurostat dissemination API
2022.economy_source: Eurostat nama_10r_3gdp, downloaded from the Eurostat dissemination API
2022.note: NUTS3 values were matched to SVG department IDs by normalized department names. Values cover metropolitan departments present in the SVG.
